summary: Read n integers and a length k such that 1 is less than or equal to k, k is less than or equal to n, and n is at most 30000. Every integer lies between -10000 and 10000. Find a contiguous block holding exactly k numbers whose mean is the greatest among all such blocks, and write that mean.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
